protocol.purpose: last bounded test of narrative gap detection
continue_to_B2: incremental_verified_gap_yield >= 1 (narrative finds a true gap the deterministic baseline misses)
narrative false positives <= deterministic false positives + 1
marginal cost per useful gap reported
protocol.retire_if_match: incremental yield == 0 and quality is not better than the deterministic baseline
protocol.end_branch_if_worse: narrative has lower precision or more false positives than the baseline
